result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on functional relations for functions z, z_1 of p (powers p^α, (p+a)^α with exponential factors e^{-απi/4}), their derivatives with respect to p, shifts by a, and determination of coefficients a, b in terms of sin and cos of (α+1)π/2.
